messages:
erin (PM): Dropping a new micro-prototype for a compact chat composer that trims chrome for embedded consoles. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/redwood/compact-chat-micro — check the 'streaming micro' frames.

maria (Design): Really like the reduced footprint. Two UX nits: token badge is noisy at micro size and the action cluster (stop/regenerate) reads as one control when width < 300px. Need clearer separation or a tiny divider.

sam (Eng): Implementation note: computing exact tokens for each stream chunk is costly. Suggest we show a short visual "~42" during stream and replace with exact count when generation completes. Estimator: ceil(char_count/4). We'll emit final accurate count from the server.

jia (DevEx): Accessibility: visual tilde is fine but SRs should hear "approximately 42 tokens". Use aria-label on the badge and a hidden live region for periodic updates: `span.sr-only[aria-live=\"polite\" aria-atomic=\"true\"]`. Throttle announcements to 300ms to avoid verbosity.

maria (Design): On copy: people conflate "Stop" with killing the whole message. Our research favors "Interrupt" for clarity but it's longer. Proposal: show full label on wide layouts, icon-only with tooltip + aria-label in micro state. I'll add both variants in fig.

erin (PM): Mobile gesture? We don't have keyboard. What if long-press on the streaming bubble reveals actions (Interrupt/Regenerate)? Show a one-time hint toast on first use.

jia (DevEx): Long-press works but not discoverable. Add a UX hint: small micro-toast "Long-press to interrupt or regenerate" shown once per session. Also expose accessible actions: for VoiceOver/TalkBack register an action "Interrupt generation" so users can trigger it without long-press.

sam (Eng): Dev detail: when user hits regenerate mid-stream, we'll spawn a new generation and crossfade the UI to avoid flash. KV cache stays intact unless we explicitly clear it. Also implement hotkeys on desktop: Esc = interrupt, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter = regenerate.

maria (Design): Color nits: current token badge text fails 4.5:1. I added two swatches in fig comments (deep slate + white, charcoal + white) that pass. Also added tiny 1px divider between badge and actions to reduce accidental taps.

erin (PM): A/B ideas: 1) Visual shows `~N` during stream vs `N est.`; 2) Tooltip copy "Interrupt (Esc)" vs "Pause (Esc)". Let's test which is clearer in the micro flow.

jia (DevEx): Note for SR: do not announce the tilde character. Use aria-label="approximately 42 tokens" while the visual reads "~42". Live region final message should be: "Generation complete  final token count: 42".

sam (Eng): Also adding a lightweight telemetry flag `compact_stream_estimator=true` when estimator is used so we can track accuracy by locale and adjust the divisor.

maria (Design): I'll add the two compact states (label + icon-only) and annotate the accessibility bits in the fig comments. Also trying both "Interrupt" and "Pause" in tooltip microcopy.

erin (PM): Great. Plan: maria updates prototype today; sam/jia open a slim PR with the estimator, aria snippets, and keyboard handlers. Preview will be deployed; we'll smoke test keyboard, SR, and mobile long-press. Target merge tomorrow afternoon. :thumbsup:

preview-bot: Preview deployed: https://preview.redwood.dev/compact-micro/1745600000 — please test keyboard navigation, VoiceOver, and long-press on mobile
